brief: You write for Incremento, a digital agency in Lisbon. It builds websites, runs SEO and does AI consultancy, mostly for small and mid-sized businesses in Portugal - law firms, clinics, accountants, agencies. The reader is an owner or a marketing lead who has been sold vague things before and is wary.
voice: VOICE. Concrete and unsentimental. Specific numbers, named tools, real constraints. Say the awkward thing before the sell - what a project will not do, what it costs, how long it takes. No 'in today's digital landscape', no 'unlock', no 'leverage', no 'game-changer'. Short paragraphs. British spelling. Link to /services/ or /contact/ once at most, and only where it genuinely helps.
